pkgmetadata.longdescription: ZoneMinder API v3, written in Rust: the API meant to replace ZoneMinder's API v2 (/zm/api, CakePHP or zm-php-api) in the long run. Until then it serves /zm/api/v3 next to API v2, on the same instance and database. It runs passive by default, so ZoneMinder's own daemons (zmdc.pl) stay in control; zm-api-takeover hands daemon control to it. Pulled in by www-misc/zoneminder[apiv3]. Upstream does not tag yet: 9999 builds master's head, and dated snapshots (Cargo.toml version plus _preYYYYMMDD of the commit date) pin master commits.
